pages.text: The Race Author: Kanchan Bannerjee Illustrators: Kavya Singh, Natasha Mehra
Four friends want to have a race with their toys.
Veena has a green car. Meena has a yellow auto.
Sanju has a red bus. Manju has a blue lorry.
Ready 1-2-3, GO! Here comes Lucky. Ha-ha, Lucky has joined the race.
Look, look! Lucky is the fastest of them all. Lucky wins the race.
